findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression injection
 * @description Using user input in regular expressions can lead to ReDoS attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/regex-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split", "fullmatch"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of regular expression function that could be vulnerable to ReDoS if user input flows to pattern."
findings.hypothesis: Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) through user-controlled regex patterns
